vulnerablePath: requireApiKey(request) proves which tenant is calling (api_keys.key_hash = sha256(bearer))
the key row id is then taken from the query string instead of the lookup
api_keys.select().eq('id', keyId) and update().eq('id', keyId) reach any tenant's key row
expectedSecureBehavior: A caller presenting tenant A's key sees and stamps tenant A's key row only, whatever id the query string names.
acceptableFixes: Use the id returned by the credential lookup (ctx.keyId) and ignore the query string
Scope the read by ctx.tenantId in addition to the id
unacceptableFixes: Checking that the query-string id merely looks like a UUID
Hiding the row's tenant_id in the response while still reading and touching the row
